messages.subject: add_dataframe and add_generator different behaviout
parts:
Hi,

I have a DES with 200 arrivals, when generating arrivals I am getting different behaviour with add_dataframe (), add_dataframe(, batch = Inf) and add_generator(). Unable to isolate issue in a reprex would appreciate any info on what might be causing this.

t1  <-  cumsum(runif(1,1,5))
dfArr <- dataframe( t1 = t1)

add_dataframe

sim1 %>% 
  add_dataframe("test",testtraj, dfArr, col_time = "t1", time = "absolute", mon = 2)  

when running get_mon_arrivals(sim1) finished == TRUE for 24.  I expect finished == FALSE for all due to a leave() function.

add_dataframe w/ batch = Inf 

sim1 %>% 
  add_dataframe("test",testtraj, dfArr, col_time = "t1", time = "absolute", mon = 2, batch = Inf) 

finished == FALSE for all

 add_generator

sim1 %>% 
  add_dataframe("test",testtraj, at(t1), mon = 2) 

finished == False for all

Given that t1 is the same for all (I set seed earlier in the script) shouldn't i get similar behaviour.

Thanks in advance and apologies for not having a reproducible example.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] add_dataframe and add_generator different behaviout
parts:
The three methods are completely equivalent, and I can't think of any
way for them to produce different results. So without a reproducible
example, I'm inclined to think that there's an issue in your script,
and some variable in your environment probably is causing the trouble.

Iñaki
